nodes.name: .npmignore
nodes.purpose: NPM package publishing configuration - excludes internal files, workspace automation, and generated outputs from published package

nodes.name: .understand-anything/.understandignore
nodes.purpose: Understanding-anything scan configuration - prevents analyzing tool artifacts and unwanted files

nodes.name: .understand-anything/config.json
nodes.purpose: Understanding-anything output language preference (English)

nodes.name: bin/nightly-scan.js
nodes.purpose: Nightly vulnerability scanning script - discovers all package.json files in workspace and runs dependency scans

nodes.name: findPackageJson
nodes.purpose: Recursively searches directory tree for package.json files up to max depth

nodes.name: bin/scan-deps.js
nodes.purpose: Dependency scanner entry point - reads package.json, filters dependencies by change status, runs batch analysis

nodes.name: main
nodes.purpose: Main async function - parses CLI arguments, loads package.json, runs GuardDog batch analysis, reports dangerous packages

nodes.name: bin/tunnel-health-check.js
nodes.purpose: SSH tunnel health check and auto-recovery - monitors 3 critical tunnels (dittofeed, job-queue, postiz) with Telegram alerts

nodes.name: legacyTunnelLabel
nodes.purpose: Creates legacy tunnel service label from suffix and hardcoded namespace

nodes.name: isAlertSuppressed
nodes.purpose: Checks if alert already sent for current outage - reads alert state file

nodes.name: markAlertSent
nodes.purpose: Writes alert state file to suppress duplicate alerts during ongoing outage

nodes.name: clearAlertState
nodes.purpose: Deletes alert state file when all tunnels recover - allows next outage to trigger fresh alert

nodes.name: probeTunnel
nodes.purpose: HTTP GET probe with 5s timeout - validates tunnel responsiveness via custom validator

nodes.name: restartTunnel
nodes.purpose: Attempts launchctl kickstart on current or legacy tunnel label - auto-recovery first step

nodes.name: sleep
nodes.purpose: Promisified sleep delay - waits for tunnel services to start after launchctl kickstart

nodes.name: sendAlert
nodes.purpose: Sends Telegram alert with tunnel names, URLs, HTTP status, and launchctl restart commands

nodes.name: GUARD_DOG_PROMPT.md
nodes.purpose: Complete setup guide and prompt for Guard Dog security agent - covers capabilities, setup steps, usage, configuration

nodes.name: MANIFEST.md
nodes.purpose: Security operations manifest - documents log structure, retention policy, daily operations, and query examples

nodes.name: OPERATIONS.md
nodes.purpose: Guard Dog + threat intelligence operations guide - covers directory structure, daily operations, alerts, and manual queries

nodes.name: PROJECT_COMPLETE.md
nodes.purpose: Subagent completion report - summarizes all requirements delivered, architecture decisions, test results, examples
